title: Dynamic Market Share
scenario: Calculate the daily market share of each company based on volume relative to the total daily volume.
tableSchema: trades (comp_id INT, trade_date DATE, vol NUMERIC)
hint: Divide daily vol by SUM(vol) OVER(PARTITION BY date).
correctQuery: SELECT comp_id, trade_date, vol::NUMERIC / SUM(vol) OVER(PARTITION BY trade_date) AS market_share FROM trades;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trades (comp_id INT, trade_date DATE, vol NUMERIC);
